main:
Our factory
in Hangzhou

A 1,500 m² production facility with 40+ CNC machines, supporting custom parts from 1 piece. An engineering team with more than 15 years in CNC machining.

Explore the equipment

parts per month

Reference capacity only. Actual output depends on part geometry, material, finishing and production mix.

CNC machining
and inspection equipment

The workshop combines machining centers, lathes, turn-mill and multi-axis machines. The equipment notes below link to the relevant machining and inspection services.

CNC machining centers

Milling pockets, profiles, bores and multi-face features.

View CNC milling capabilities
CNC lathes & turn-mill equipment

Rotational parts, threads and components combining turned and milled features.

View turning capabilities
Multi-axis machining

Machining angled features and curved surfaces to your drawing.

Check your part size and setup
Dimensional inspection

CMM, height gauges and optical projectors for checking part dimensions.

View quality control

Dimensional inspection
against your drawing

We use CMM, height gauges and optical projectors to check part dimensions. Inspection scope and measurement methods are confirmed in your quotation, based on the drawing and requirements.

View quality control
Our working process
See how we work

The quotation sets out the work, approval steps and delivery requirements. Sample approval and the agreed inspection plan guide the move into production.

Requirements & quotation

Confirm requirements and evaluate your drawing or model before agreeing the quotation.

Sample & inspection

Machine the sample or prototype, then inspect it and review the results with you.

Approval & production

Proceed to production after sample approval, with the agreed requirements in place.

Final QC & shipment

Complete final quality checks and prepare the parts and agreed documents for dispatch.
